title: HugMesh worklist envelope (v1)
description: The frozen wire format for a mesh build worklist: an envelope around one base ImageConfig plus a list of per-image entries (one per role x platform). Emitted by the Studio (core/worklist.py WorklistConfig.to_dict) and the web admin-ui; validated by a Studio test AND the admin-bff bean validator (spec item 10). The `schema` key is the mandatory discriminator: ImageConfig.load rejects any JSON carrying it, and worklist.load_any routes it here. Anything WITHOUT a top-level `schema` key is a flat single-image ImageConfig and is NOT described by this schema.

schema.description: Version discriminator. MUST be present and exact for the envelope to be recognized.

entries.description: One entry per image the worklist builds (one per role x platform combo).

worklistEntry.description: A single image: a role x platform pair plus its per-image axes. `id` is the STABLE identity `f"{role}.{platform}"` used for domain attachment (Domain.images) and the derived per-image build_subdir `wl-<id>` (build_subdir is NOT stored on the wire). additionalProperties is FALSE on purpose: every key WorklistEntry.to_dict writes must be declared here, so a new per-image axis cannot reach the wire without this contract being updated with it — that is what studio/tests/test_worklist.py::test_envelope_conforms_to_frozen_schema gates.

id.description: Stable entry id `{role}.{platform}`. Derived from role/platform when omitted; honored verbatim on load for an exact round-trip.

encrypt_root.description: Per-image root-encryption override. `default` inherits the worklist-wide Home-page default; jetson rows are forced off in materialize regardless.

packages_add.description: Space-separated Portage atoms added to this image on top of the builder-derived default set. Each atom MUST match ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9+._-]*/[A-Za-z0-9+._-]+$ (validate_package_atoms).

packages_drop.description: Space-separated Portage atoms removed from this image's default set (honoring the mandatory-payload floor). Same per-atom charset as packages_add.

infra_services.description: Per-node scope:node infra services (core/worklist.py WORKLIST_INFRA_SERVICES), ADDITIVE to the mesh-wide Network-page default. materialize() folds each onto the image through that platform's REAL builder mechanism (x86 tor -> --with-tor; rpi5 tor/egress-vpn -> --optional-services) and drops a slug the platform cannot express, so a per-node toggle never becomes a flag the builder ignores. The vocabulary is closed: WORKLIST_INFRA_SERVICES is the enum below.

desktop_user.description: The PERSON on a desktop-class entry. materialize() stamps desktop_user_role as --person-role on this entry's own image and derives a manifest User (carrying desktop_user_roles) on the internal Tailscale root domain. Node entries always leave this blank.

desktop_user_role.description: That person's TIER (config.py PERSON_ROLE_CHOICES) — the one value --person-role takes. Meaningful only alongside a non-blank desktop_user. Multi-role (issue #228): the highest tier in desktop_user_roles; a reader that knows only this key loses nothing it read before.

desktop_user_roles.description: ALL the roles the person's account holds (issue #228): the tier plus any grants, in config.py USER_ROLE_CHOICES precedence order (grants are games / games-services). OMITTED when the account holds exactly its tier, so absent == [desktop_user_role] and a one-tier entry keeps its pre-#228 bytes; when present it always contains the tier, hence at least two items. desktop_users() hands the whole set to the derived manifest User's `roles`; the image itself takes only the tier.

hostname.description: PER-IMAGE hostname (issue #229) — this image's -H/--hostname. "" inherits base.hostname, and a blank base lets the builder derive the role name. materialize() fails loudly when two entries would bake the same explicit name. Timezone and the default account stay mesh-wide on the base.

imageConfig.description: A serialized ImageConfig (core/config.py ImageConfig.to_dict). The single-image plane — identity, network, domains, users, system, disk-encryption default. Only the load-bearing shared fields are pinned here; the full field set evolves with the dataclass, so unknown keys are tolerated (from_dict drops them). Plaintext SECRET_FIELDS (local_pass/luks_pass/user_password/root_password) are ALWAYS blanked on the wire.

superdomain.description: Tailscale root domain all mesh nodes join; "" = derived <brand>.internal. NON_ARGV: manifest + KEYS channel, never a builder flag; permanently internal (I7).

domain.description: A cluster domain. `images` holds worklist entry-id refs this domain attaches to (empty = every eligible image). The legacy `games: bool` field was DROPPED — from_dict migrates a truthy value into optional_services += ["games"].

user.description: One provisioning account. `role` is the PRIMARY role every consumer reads (the highest tier the account holds: superadmin > admin > mod > user, then games / games-services). `roles` (issue #228) is the FULL set the account holds, in that precedence order; it is OMITTED when the account holds exactly one role, so absent == [role] and a single-role row keeps its pre-#228 bytes. A reader that knows only `role` loses nothing it read before.
